svg.title: For l ̸= 0, choose a coordinate attaining grade(l) = 1 + maxa | lift(l)a|. The lower alias estimate gives BM,L,l ≥(c−ζ)2 grade(l)2 on the real cube. The holomorphic upper bound is C grade(l)2. Apply the reciprocal estimate with wl = grade(l)2 to obtain a fixed complex collar and |B−1 M,L,l| ≤ C′ grade(l)−2, uniformly in M, L, l ̸= 0. The principal alias instead satisfies the exact identity BM,L,0 = λLM and is not inverted on a collar containing zero. Define mix(l) = Y a (1 + | lift(l)a|), decayj(l) = mix(l)−j.
